_comment: REAL FLIGHT. Requires the --i-know-this-arms-real-drones CLI gate AND preflight P0-P10 passing AND the operator typing GO. Every value here is re-validated onsite (gates A-E) before any mission. camera_hfov_deg is bench-measured; until set, sightings carry bearing_deg=null.
_detector_note: ArUco is the primary detector and always runs (convoy robots carry markers to detect + READ; marker->robot ID map goes in drone zone/config once the briefing lands). YOLO stays OFF unless the briefing scores marker-less spotting — enabling it is one edit: backend 'ultralytics' + RoboMaster-trained weights.
